sections.title: Identification
sections.text: Calocybe gambosa is a stout spring mushroom. Its fleshy white to cream cap is usually 3–10 cm wide but can grow larger, changing from rounded to convex or nearly flat while often retaining an inrolled margin. The narrow white to cream gills are very crowded and attached to the stem. The stem is short, thick and solid, without ring or volva. The flesh is thick and white, and the spore print cream-white. A strong smell of fresh flour is common but not unique to this species.

sections.title: Habitat and season
sections.text: It fruits mainly in spring, from April to June depending on region, in grassland, at woodland edges, in orchards and beside hedges, sometimes under trees. Groups can form arcs or rings and recur at the same place. Season is context, not proof.

sections.title: Look-alikes to exclude
sections.text: The deadly red-staining fibrecap (Inosperma erubescens, formerly Inocybe erubescens) can fruit in spring near woodland edges; it reddens when damaged, its gills turn brown and its spore print is tobacco-brown. The poisonous livid pinkgill (Entoloma sinuatum), mainly autumnal, can also smell mealy, but its gills become pinkish and its print is pink. The deadly spring amanita has free gills, a ring and a basal sack. Smell or season alone cannot decide edibility.

sections.title: Edibility and caution
sections.text: The DGfM and VAPKO list C. gambosa as edible. Check the whole specimen, gill colour and attachment, stem base and, when needed, the spore print. Do not eat an uncertain collection.

traits: Fleshy white to cream cap with often inrolled margin
White to cream, very crowded, attached gills
Short, stout, solid stem without ring or volva
Thick white flesh; cream-white spore print
Spring in grass and at woodland edges, sometimes in arcs or rings
safetyNote: Edible only after reliable identification. The deadly red-staining fibrecap also fruits in spring; livid pinkgill and spring amanita are further dangerous look-alikes. A mealy smell is insufficient. Have uncertain collections checked.
